screener_note: Clip is clean (no caricature/mascot/diet). Concern: the ad's slogan 'The only good bug is a dead bug' echoes a slur phrase; an Archive review flags it. Caption was rewritten to NOT lead with the slogan, but the clip (17.2-29.3 s) still shows the slogan flag at ~24.5-27 s. Options: post as is, or drop and swap (e.g. Sani-Flush 1961). Audio and between-sample frames not checked.
risk: Post-1930, copyright renewal unknown; slogan-echo question for the Director.
